rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter (`name: habeas-evidence`), so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`.

The requirement obliges a site to say when to read the file for each link it uses to specialized material. The skill has three such links, and each one says when:
- `references/fixme.md`: in the "Fixing findings" table, on the row "a real gap the user agrees to defer, a FIXME judgment, or a `{fixme}` issue that closed", whose action is "read [references/fixme.md]".
- `references/reviews.md`: in the same table, on the row "false citation or site review", whose action is "read [references/reviews.md]".
- `references/authoring-failures.md`: in the Gotchas section, under "If authoring fails on configuration, credentials, throttling, or a denied mandatory input, read …".

I found no other links to files in the skill. The mentions of other skills, such as habeas-requirements and habeas-refactor, are not links to files. The listed matches contained no violation queries, so there are no violation leads to judge. I found no gap.
